outcome: Success rate of vaginal birth after cesarean (VBAC)
cohort: 400 women with subsequent pregnancies who underwent elective repeat cesarean delivery or TOLAC following primary cesarean delivery
finding: The rate of successful VBAC among women who chose TOLAC was 84.93%, suggesting that VBAC can be offered to pregnant women without contraindications with high success rates.
